changes.summary: Unify two equivalent civil-date calculations in private cli::civil_date; keep clocks and output formatting at root.

evidence: No schema, flags, defaults or routing changes.
Date module matches both originals on era sweep and signed timestamp samples; source review confirms caller formats and clock reads unchanged.
No command execution, persistence or confirmation branches changed.

New private module receives only an i64 day count, returns a value, and has no I/O/clock/Store capability. All three callers retain time acquisition and formatting.
cargo test --locked -p ab-bridge --test cli_civil_date: four tests passed, including pinned reference source binding.
cargo check --locked -p ab-bridge --all-targets --quiet passed with existing warnings; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Data/ab-main-rs-governance-target CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4.
